guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest memory change (47MB to 123MB, +163%), a socket increase (4 to 18.9), and latency-90 up to 6.6s. The frontend warnings 'failed to get product recommendations' and error spans in recommendationservice traces fit this, but productcatalogservice latency also spiked (3.66s p90) and is a downstream callee, so the culprit is not certain.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the recommendationservice pods and raise their memory limits, then check for a memory leak or cache growth. Also check productcatalogservice health, since recommendationservice depends on it.
